backoffice.title: Back office
backoffice.subtitle: Data entry, moderation and database quality
backoffice.pinRequired: Drop the pin on the map
backoffice.pinRequiredHint: Blocking step: click the map at the exact location. No address is ever auto-geocoded.
backoffice.dedupQueueHint: Partial matches to decide by hand. The algorithm never merges an ambiguous case on its own.
backoffice.searchMissesHint: The best health indicator for the alias table. Work through it weekly.
backoffice.expiringSoonHint: Telegram nudge at D-7: one-tap “still available?”.
backoffice.photoReuseHint: Same perceptual hash across unrelated properties — sign of fraud or copying.
backoffice.auditLogHint: Moderation actions, append-only. Each entry is written in the same transaction as the action it describes: there can be no merge without its trace.
backoffice.auditRetentionNote: Purging always archives first: npm run audit:retention
backoffice.submissionsHint: Listings received from a feed or the bot with everything but a location. Blocking step: no property is created until the pin is placed.
backoffice.translationsHint: Only premium agencies' listings go to human review (§4.1). The rest stay flagged as machine-translated on the public page.

footer.disclaimer: Ownership information shown is as declared. Always verify the title with the land registry before transacting.
